title: The Tuesday Club
description: Walk through 1890s Chicago as Rosa and follow one girls' club at Hull House from its first meeting to its goodbye. The game pauses three times for group activities.
players: Groups of 4, one phone per pair
concept: Social group work: what makes a group, stages of group development, social goals model (Ch. 5)

title: Term Duel
description: Rock-paper-scissors your way around the room: win and name a term, lose and explain it. Tick off every term on your own phone.
concept: Course vocabulary: What Makes a Group; Group Stages & Social Goals

title: Storm Over Clear Creek
description: A typhoon is coming and the county wants to close the village. Map Clear Creek's hidden assets, lead a rescue through an old tunnel on typhoon night, then win over the county official at the town hall.
players: Solo on a phone, a pair on one phone, or a pair on the projector with an 8BitDo
concept: Community work: what makes a community, NBCD vs. ABCD, community principles, Rothman's three models, PARK, practice steps (Ch. 6)

title: Term Flip
description: Flashcards for exam review: see the English term, say the Chinese and explain it, then flip to check. Cards you miss come back until you know them all.
players: Solo or in pairs, on a phone, keyboard, or 8BitDo
concept: Course vocabulary, Ch. 1–7 (every English–Chinese pair checked against the textbook)
